entities.name: Katherine Clerk Maxwell
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Katherine Mary Clerk Maxwell was a Scottish physicist. The wife of James Clerk Maxwell, she aided him in some of his work on colour vision and his experiments on the viscosity of gases. She was born Katherine Dewar in 1824 in Glasgow and married Clerk Maxwell in Aberdeen in 1858.
